# Form 22 — Your application

Enter three occupants and select **No** for pets. If your wife is also applying as a tenant, she needs to complete a separate Form 22.

## Property and occupants

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| B01 Property manager or owner | NEEDS-YOU. Full name, phone, email and agency details if applicable. |
| B02 Premises address | Brisbane. NEEDS-YOU. Exact property address and postcode. |
| B03 Submission methods | NEEDS-YOU. The property manager or owner supplies both methods. |
| B04 Total occupants | **3** |
| B05 Occupants under 18 | NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether your daughter is under 18 to determine the count. |

## Applicant details

**B06 Full name**  
Join the three restored values by hand in the order your name appears on your passport.

## Employment and supporting documents

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| B11 Current employer | NEEDS-YOU. Your current employer. |
| B12 Job title | NEEDS-YOU. Your job title. |
| B13 Employment and income | NEEDS-YOU. Length of employment and gross weekly income. |
| B14 Employer contact details | NEEDS-YOU. Employer name, phone and email. |
| B15 Financial information | NEEDS-YOU. The property manager or owner specifies the requested documents. If you can’t provide current employment or income details, add other evidence of your ability to pay rent here. |
| B16 Identity verification | NEEDS-YOU. The property manager or owner specifies which identity documents to provide. |
| B17 Applicant suitability | NEEDS-YOU. The property manager or owner specifies which supporting documents to provide. |

## Rental history

**B18 Property 1 address**  
Use your current Manchester address. Copy the postcode by hand into its separate box if it appears in the restored address. Otherwise, NEEDS-YOU for the postcode.

14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| B19 Rental period | **March 2020 to present** |
| B20 Property 1 manager or owner | NEEDS-YOU. Name, email and phone. |
| B21 Property 2 | NEEDS-YOU if you have an earlier rental. Provide its address, postcode, rental period and the manager’s or owner’s name, email and phone. |
| B22 Prior living arrangements | Leave blank. You have rental history. |

## References and pets

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| B23 First referee | NEEDS-YOU. Name, phone, email and relationship to you. |
| B24 Second referee | NEEDS-YOU. Name, phone, email and relationship to you. |
| B25 Rules about keeping pets | NEEDS-YOU. The property manager or owner supplies this answer. |
| B26 Do you intend to keep pets? | **No** |
| B27 Pet details | Leave blank. |
